Subject: Re: Upcoming sked 
 
This looks good.  
Enjoy the break.
Merry Christmas.
On Dec 22, 2018, at 4:21 PM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

For your upcoming schedules, I gotta take some time off since soon there isn't going to be any time off. Here's a proposed schedule for the next month, subject to change with the late-winter schedule.

I've been talking to Ron and Jerry Lewis about attending the Tigers 1984 fantasy camp in late January -- its the 35th anniversary for that team -- which would be a really cool story with videos and stuff. I'm trying to plan my spring training preview around that, to see which prospects and players will be arriving early, to knock two things out at once. I will be circling back with them after the New Year.
Merry Christmas to you and the fam. Enjoy some time away.
